header.title: About Us
header.subtitle: Discover the story behind 45+ years of MEP engineering excellence in the Gulf region.

story.heading: Engineering Excellence
story.description: Al Jazira for Imdad Smart Company (formerly known as IMDAD Group) is a leading name in the MEP construction sector in the Gulf region. With over 45 years of proven experience, the company continues to specialize in Mechanical and Electrical construction, offering complete, collaborative, and end-to-end solutions that bring life to new buildings and sustain existing ones.
story.descriptionExtra: Starting as IMDAD sanitary works in KSA, the company diversified and constantly followed the market. For over 45 years, the team has been reinforcing its international presence in the Gulf, expanding its in-house expertise and enlarging its scope of MEP Engineering services.
story.founderQuote: Developing and serving society with the highest levels of professional integrity and commitment.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.description: To safely deliver world-class Quality MEP projects and infrastructure projects on time, promoting environmental protection and sustainable community development.
pillars: Engineering Excellence — Providing comprehensive and effective solutions across all mechanical, electrical, and plumbing works.
Safety First — Strictly following occupational health and safety standards to protect individuals and assets at all sites.
Sustainability — Implementing eco-friendly solutions that reduce energy consumption and contribute to sustainable community development.
Customer Focus — Understanding client needs and adapting services to ensure full satisfaction with tailored solutions.
Innovation — Developing innovative technologies and solutions to enhance project efficiency without compromising quality.

vision.heading: Our Vision
vision.description: To become a regional market leader in the MEP Construction Industry, providing engineering excellence to valued clients through commitment to delivering best practices in corporate governance and transparency.
